listingTitle: Replace a repeated dynamic map shape with a struct
title: Replace a repeated dynamic map shape with a struct
why: A stable domain shape passed through string-keyed dynamic maps gives up Rust's ability to encode field names, value contracts, and valid construction in the type system.
suggestion: Introduce a struct with typed fields and validated construction when these keys represent one domain concept.
limitations: Requires the same complete set of four to twelve literal keys on an explicit HashMap, BTreeMap, serde_json::Map, or qualified serde_json::Value parameter in at least three functions across two files, or at least four functions in one file.

Only direct string-literal indexing and get, get_mut, contains_key, or remove calls are recognized; type aliases, computed keys, partial shape overlap, and interprocedural value flow are not resolved.
Typed structs, inline test functions, comments, string examples, local maps, non-dynamic map value types, and shapes below the project-level repetition threshold are excluded.
